correctness.rationale: For the specific smooth Q:x0x1+y0y1=z² over C and disjoint conics Cx,Cy, the pencil [y0:y1] resolves on X=Bl_(Cx union Cy)Q. In y1=1 chart, y0=z²-x0x1; blow up (x0,x1) via x0=u,x1=uv, so t=z²-u²v exactly. For t !=0,infinity, Q_t:x0x1+t y1²=z² has full-rank quadric matrix, and the two centers on Q_t are distinct points; their blowup yields smooth degree-six del Pezzo and Euler 6. For t=0 the scheme fiber is z²=u²v: reduced, integral (v nonsquare), Jacobian support u=z=0, generically transverse two branches, with pinch at v=0 and at v'=0 in the opposite blowup chart. Explicit integral normalization v=w²,z=uw; overlap w'=1/w,u'=uw² gives the negative O(-2) section and agrees globally with finite proper quasi-finite birational morphism F2->special fiber induced from quadric cone resolution. Conductor (u,z) in base ring pulls back to (u); negative section maps [a:b]->[a²:b²] and is branched at exactly two points. Blowups and base symmetries exhaust all 0,infinity special fibers for BOTH projections. Euler 4 from F2 minus source conductor P1 plus image conductor P1, independently e(X)=e(Q)+2+2=8 and 2 special fibers. Proof is algebraic for all claimed fibers, not a finite experiment. Both the exact pinned verifier and independent symbolic/checker calculations confirm the necessary local substitutions and topology identities without pretending to establish global finiteness by computation.

value.rationale: Gao's explicit Fano threefold has two geometrically natural degree-six del Pezzo fibrations important to the arithmetic exceptional-set study. Determining the COMPLETE exceptional-fiber loci and their precise irreducible nonnormal normalization/conductor, branch and Euler changes gives an intrinsic exact degeneration classification for this motivated object. It clarifies information absent from the generic-fiber description. Reid supplies general possible surface types, but applying the type to the concrete scheme-theoretic fibers is not merely renaming an entry: it requires identifying the blowup-specialization geometry and proving completeness in the actual pencils. This finite but complete classification is independently useful to geometers studying this specific fibration; no claim of generalizing all family No. 3-10 or inventing the surface type is made.

final_claim: For each of two coordinate degree-six del Pezzo fibrations on X=Bl_(Cx disjoint Cy){x0x1+y0y1=z²} over C, the only singular geometric fibers are the reduced integral nonnormal ones over [0:1] and [1:0], each locally z²=u²v, normalized by F2 with conductor negative section of self-intersection -2 mapping by the degree-two squaring map, two Whitney pinch points, Euler 4; every other fiber smooth degree-six del Pezzo of Euler 6; e(X)=8.
